bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$root"
git fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
git cat-file -e 6faacd0b34c4238e1c342e8495c07add030e9c13^{commit}
test -d scripts
if test -e scripts/userbot_session.py; then
 test "$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_session.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(git show 6faacd0b34c4238e1c342e8495c07add030e9c13:scripts/userbot_session.py | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 71
else
 git show 6faacd0b34c4238e1c342e8495c07add030e9c13:scripts/userbot_session.py > scripts/userbot_session.py
fi
python3 -m venv deploy/.userbot-venv
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python -m pip install --quiet 'telethon>=1.36,<2'
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python -m pip show telethon >/dev/null
test -f deploy/secrets/userbot.env
test "$(stat -c %a deploy/secrets/userbot.env)" = 600
python3 -B -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("scripts/userbot_session.py").read())'
echo USERBOT_ENROLLMENT_TERMINAL_READY
